🚗 CarPlay / Android Auto

Broady is a full-screen web app. Add it to your iPhone or Android home screen and it runs like a native app — no browser chrome, no address bar.
  1. Plug in or connect via Bluetooth to your vehicle's infotainment system.
  2. Open Broady from your CarPlay or Android Auto home screen.
  3. Voice commands work through "Hey Bro" — just like on your phone.

Need setup help? Apple CarPlay guide ↗ · Android Auto guide ↗

CarPlay / Android Auto
🚗

Use Broady in Your Vehicle

Broady is a Progressive Web App (PWA). To use it hands-free on your dash:

📱
Step 1 — Add to Home Screen
iPhone: tap Share → Add to Home Screen. Android: tap Menu → Install App.
🔌
Step 2 — Connect to Your Vehicle
Plug in via USB or connect via Bluetooth. Open CarPlay or Android Auto on your dash.
🗺️
Step 3 — Open Broady
Find Broady in your vehicle display. Tap to open the installed PWA version.
🍎 Apple CarPlay Guide 🤖 Android Auto Guide
